_comment: Machine-readable conformance spec for the agent review gate. Anchors are FIXED legal boilerplate that must survive intact in every Official Rules document; allowed_fields are the ONLY things a study is expected to change. Source of truth: 'Open Source Community Happiness Study Sweepstakes Official Rules 2026.pdf' (CELA-approved template). Token-containment threshold is intentionally forgiving to tolerate PDF text-extraction glitches.
canonical_template: Open Source Community Happiness Study Sweepstakes Official Rules 2026.pdf
